description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeNotification" name="Employee incident or safety notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorateReport" name="Fatal or serious work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Qualifying work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed person's accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentDirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport" name="School or educational institution accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateAccidentReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider" name="Private insurance provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate employee notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Immediate report if not reported to emergency services" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInsurance" name="Report qualifying accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurance" name="Report accident in good time" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolToInsurance" name="Report within five days in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateToProvider" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateAccident" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToProvider" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Gather accident information and notify employer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Work accident, near accident, serious immediate risk or protection-system defect occurs or is discovered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Start_Gather</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" name="Gather incident circumstances and identify applicable accident category">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, the circumstances may include a location, time and cause related to insured employment; working from home; direct routes between residence, work, lunch, training, a doctor or childcare; carpools; professional training; a notified doctor's visit interrupting a direct route; taking a supervised child to or from care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, circumstances may include a location, time and cause related to insured education or compulsory kindergarten, school or school-related events, direct routes between residence or permanent accommodation and the educational facility, prescribed practical curriculum or study tasks, and certain professional orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered work may also include qualifying household work, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction or repair of establishment buildings, and neighbourhood assistance. Accidents treated as work accidents outside professional activity may include use of Unemployment Insurance Act or Labour Market Promotion Act services, assistance at an accident, blood donation, or training, exercises or service with the listed volunteer aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Start_Gather</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Gather_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Gather_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employee_Notify_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeNotification" name="Employer informed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employee_Notify_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Start_Gather" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Gather_Notify" sourceRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Notify_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeNotification"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerNotification" name="Employee notification received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Employer_Start_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployerNotification" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EmployerSplit" name="Evaluate independent reporting duties">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Employer_Start_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_LabourCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_InsuranceCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabourCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury not reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_Labour_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_LabourCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Labour_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Labour_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorateReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Labour_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Labour_Report_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LabourMerge" name="Complete Labour Inspectorate reporting path">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Labour_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Labour_Report_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabourMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceCheck" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days, in full or in part?" default="Flow_Insurance_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_InsuranceCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurance provider within five days" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Insurance_Report_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Complete accident insurance reporting path">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Insurance_Report_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EmployerJoin" name="Independent reporting paths complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabourMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmployerJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerReporting" name="Employer reporting duties completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmployerJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Start_Split" sourceRef="Start_EmployerNotification" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_LabourCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit" targetRef="Gateway_LabourCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_InsuranceCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Labour_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Fatality or serious injury occurred and the accident has not been reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Labour_No" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourCheck" targetRef="Gateway_LabourMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Labour_Report_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_LabourMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabourMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_LabourMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A person with accident insurance was killed or is unable to work for three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Report_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerJoin" targetRef="End_EmployerReporting"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Accident involves self-employed person or a person they employ">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfEmployed_Start_Report</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfEmployed_Start_Report</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfEmployed_Report_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReport" name="Accident reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfEmployed_Report_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReport"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Student or schoolchild has an accident">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Student_Start_Report</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" messageRef="Message_StudentDirectorateReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Student_Start_Report</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Student_Report_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReport" name="Competent directorate informed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Student_Report_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_StudentReport"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_School" name="School and educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_School_Start_Report</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days in triplicate" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_School_Start_Report</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_School_Report_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReport" name="Accident reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_School_Report_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Report_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="End_SchoolReport"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Privately insured person has an accident">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Private_Start_Report</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateAccident" name="Report accident in writing immediately under policy conditions" messageRef="Message_PrivateAccidentReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Private_Start_Report</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatalityCheck" name="Were there fatalities?" default="Flow_Private_NoFatality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Private_Fatality</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Private_NoFatality</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatalities within three days, even if the accident was already reported" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Private_Fatality</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Private_Fatality_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Fatality reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Private_Fatality_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateAccidentReport" name="Accident report completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Private_NoFatality</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateAccident" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A fatality occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_NoFatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatalityCheck" targetRef="End_PrivateAccidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
